Variants.Content: Totava Fort is located in the northeastern part of the Narrow Sea and the Braavos shipping route, and is politically within the political network of Braavos and its adjacent coast. It is a castle mainly responsible for local garrison, tax collection and sheltering the nearby population. Walls and roads tied the surrounding population, storage, and garrison here; even if the flags were changed, this stronghold would still affect how nearby people paid taxes, traded, and sought refuge.
Entry Tutava Keep Local families also rely on water, roads, arable land, herds, and markets where goods can be exchanged; if any road, well, or dock fails, the price falls first on them.

Entry Tutava Keep If you can supply supplies, avoid danger, and find a guide, it is worth marking in your itinerary; if you don't have these three things, no matter how loud your family name is, it won't be able to save the lost.
Entry Tutava Keep A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.

Entry Tutava Keep They care about water sources, roads, cultivated land, herds, and markets where goods can be exchanged. They also look at whether seeds are left after harvesting grain and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see coats of arms, what they see is whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
